plan.notes: Source: official Lehman College undergraduate catalog, Computer Science COMSC-BS (Software Engineering Track) Degree Map, 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (Contemporary): https://lehman-undergraduate.catalog.cuny.edu/programs/COMSC-BS . Cross-checked against the official Lehman career-infused degree map PDF for the same track (Bachelor of Science: Computer Science, Track: Software Engineering): https://www.lehman.edu/media/Student-Affairs/Career-Exploration-amp-Development-Center/documents/Lehman-College-Career-Infused-Degree-Map---BS-Computer-Science-(Software-Engineering-Track)-.pdf . Transcription method: machine-read from the catalog page's embedded degree-map JSON (course IDs resolved against official catalog course pages for code/title/credits), then verified term-by-term against the career PDF. Track note: the BS in Computer Science (COMSC-BS) is offered in five tracks (System, Web Development, Software Engineering, Mobile Programming, Artificial Intelligence); this file transcribes the Software Engineering track, the track with a full official term-by-term degree map. Credit discrepancy (documented honestly): the career PDF prints Total Credits 122 with the Fall Year 3 major elective at 3 cr; the current catalog degree map labels that slot 'Major Elective (4 cr)', giving a transcribed term total of 14 and an overall total of 123 (18+17+16+13+14+18+12+15). total_credits uses the catalog's 123. The older career PDF also lists CMP 465 Technical Interview Preparation (prereq CMP 338) and optional CED 102 in Year 2; CMP 465 does not appear in the current catalog degree map and was omitted, while optional CED 102 and CMP 485 are kept as 0-credit required_zero entries with notes. Six catalog course pages timed out during verification (LEH 250, LEH 355, CMP 232, CMP 340, CMP 410, CMP 346); their code/title/credits are confirmed by the official career PDF at the same map positions and by the catalog's own requirement tables (CMP 232 = Discrete Mathematics 4 cr) and the Lehman math/CS department program pages. Math sequencing note: the catalog's math generic states the math course sequence is determined by placement (MAT 126, MAT 171, MAT 172, or MAT 175); this map follows the MAT 172 start. Lab/lecture corequisite pairs are placed in the same term per the official map (CMP 167+CMP 157, CMP 168+CMP 158, MAT 175+MAT 155, MAT 176+MAT 156). CMP 338 prerequisites (CMP 232, CMP 157, CMP 158, CMP 168) are from its official catalog course page. All Lehman students must also complete Writing Intensive (WI) courses (four for entering freshmen).
